title: Map numbers to positions
summary: A linear scale maps one number range to another.
introduction: A linear scale maps one number range to another. Your task: Calculate where x(100) will be.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for map numbers to positions

blocks.text: A linear scale maps one number range to another. The domain is the data range, and the range is the drawing range.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

blocks.title: Map numbers to positions

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `scaleLinear` maps numeric input values from its domain into output positions in its range.

blocks.text: The value 50 maps to the middle of the drawing range, x=160.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A domain is about data; a range is about output positions. Reversing them gives the wrong mapping.
